Nine women die after surgery in Rajasthan hospitals

Nine women have died following surgeries in two towns in Rajasthan within a week. The deaths occurred after C-section deliveries in government hospitals. The state government has dispatched expert teams to investigate the incidents, which have raised concerns about the health system.
